collection.title: Mercedes-Benz C Class Estate 2007 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz C Class Estate 2007 to 2008 (C204) model requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Side Pin wiper arm attachment and all of the following blades will fit. We also have rear blade for this C Class Estate, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
